verdict.rationale: Parahelp's Customer Agent can call tools built on any service with an API, such as Stripe or internal endpoints. Tools are shared across agents, and the agent can act on account attributes like enterprise status. That is a documented first-party way to bring customer-specific data into resolutions beyond help articles, but the docs never show the agent looking up plan, order status, or account history to compose answers. missing for 10: explicit documentation of live customer-data lookups (plan, order status, account history) feeding answers, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, answers use the customer's live data — plan, order status, account history — not just generic help articles

citations.quote: Tools can use any service with an API: public integrations like Stripe, or your own internal endpoints.
Connect a tool once, and both agents can use it
When a ticket is about an enterprise account, transfer it to the enterprise team with a summary note.
Describe the flow you want in natural language - the policies, knowledge, and tool connections it combines - and the Internal Agent configures it.
